decision_basis: Underlying hospital profit/EBITDA growth provides a substantive upside case, but 30.38x trailing earnings, material net debt and RM141m conservative cash against RM486m dividends leave owner-return compensation balanced. Growth has not yet delivered financial repair.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager: measured payout/conversion costs at the premium offset real hospital growth, rather than missing certainty vetoing growth.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
